Five hundred catalogue queries were run using three request types: search by community, period filtering, and retrieval of complete metadata. Median latency was 420 ms, and the 95th percentile was 1.84 seconds. Thirteen queries exceeded three seconds.

Slow queries combine a broad period, several filters, and sorting by date. Analysis shows that the catalogue first retrieves all candidates and applies part of the filtering in the application layer. The proposal is to create indexes for community and time range and move the granularity filter into the data store.

Nuria will implement the indexes in pre-production and repeat the test with the same load. The target is a 95th percentile below 1.5 seconds and zero errors. Optimization must not change result ordering or access rules. Sergio will preserve queries and metrics for comparison.
